description: Gotoh GE1996T double-locking tremolo: a base plate that rocks on two hardened knife edges bearing on posts set in insert bushings, carrying one saddle, clamp block and clamp screw per string, with a sustain block hanging below. Two published sizes (6- and 7-string) drive the whole plan - span, post spacing and saddle radius all follow string count - while plate thickness, post, bushing and saddle block stay fixed across the line. Saddle heights are derived: their tops lie on the fingerboard-radius cylinder, R350 for six strings and R430 for seven. Plate rock about the knife edges is an operating state, not a dimension.
source: Gotoh dimension sheets GE1996T-Dim.pdf and GE1996T-7-Dim.pdf (https://g-gotoh.com/images/pdf/GE1996T-Dim.pdf, https://g-gotoh.com/images/pdf/GE1996T-7-Dim.pdf) and the product page https://g-gotoh.com/product/ge1996t/?lang=en; no dimensional standard exists for this part, so everything the sheets do not dimension is documented as proportion in NOTES.md
